--- arithmetic
on t(x, y)
    return {x + y, x - y, x * y, x / y, x div y, x mod y, x ^ y, -x, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x - (y - 1), x / (y / 2)}
end t
--- comparisons symbols
on t(x, y)
    return {x = y, x ≠ y, x < y, x > y, x ≤ y, x ≥ y, x <= y, x >= y, x /= y}
end t
--- comparisons words
on t(x, y)
    return {x is y, x is equal to y, x equals y, x is not y, x isn't y, x is not equal to y, x does not equal y, x is less than y, x is greater than y, x comes before y, x comes after y, x is less than or equal to y, x is greater than or equal to y, x is not less than y, x is not greater than y}
end t
--- containment
on t(x, y)
    return {x contains y, x does not contain y, x doesn't contain y, x starts with y, x begins with y, x ends with y, x is in y, x is contained by y, x is not in y, x is not contained by y, x isn't contained by y}
end t
--- containment negated
on t(x, y)
    return {not (x contains y), not (x starts with y), not (x ends with y), not (x is in y), x does not start with y, x does not end with y}
end t
--- logic
on t(a, b, c)
    return {a and b, a or b, not a, a and b and c, a or b or c, a and (b or c), (a and b) or c, not (a and b), not a and not b, a and not (b or not c)}
end t
--- logic with comparisons
on t(x, y, z)
    return {x = 1 and y = 2, x < y or y < z, not (x = y), x ≠ y and not (y = z), (x > 0 and y > 0) or z = 0, x is 1 or x is 2 or x is 3}
end t
--- logic as conditions
on t(x, y)
    if x > 0 and y > 0 then return 1
    if x > 0 or y > 0 then return 2
    if not (x > 0) then return 3
    if x > 0 and (y > 0 or y < -10) and not (x = y) then return 4
    return 0
end t
--- logic short circuit values
on t(x, y)
    set a to x is missing value or y is missing value
    set b to x is not missing value and length of x > 0
    return {a, b}
end t
--- concatenation
on t(x, y)
    return {x & y, x & y & x, x & "a" & y & "b", {x} & {y}, x & {y}, {x} & y, "a" & 1, 1 & "a", x & (y as text), (x as text) & y}
end t
--- coercion chains
on t(x)
    return {x as text as list, (x as integer) as text, x as text & "s", (x & "s") as text, x + 1 as text, (x + 1) as text, x as integer + 1}
end t
--- reference forms
on t(x)
    set r to a reference to x
    set s to a reference to item 1 of x
    set c to contents of r
    set contents of s to 5
    return {r, s, c, contents of s, a reference to length of x}
end t
--- unary mixes
on t(x, y)
    return {-x + y, x + -y, -(x * y), -x * y, not x = y, not (x = y), (not x) = y, - -x, -(-x)}
end t
--- parenthesized author style
on t(x, y)
    return {(x), ((x + y)), (x) + (y), ((x) * (y)) + 1, (x = y), ((x) = (y)) and (x > 0)}
end t
--- mixed precedence
on t(a, b, c, d)
    return {a + b * c - d / a, a * b + c * d, (a + b) * (c - d), a + b & c + d, a & b = c & d, a + b = c + d, a = b & c, a < b + c, a mod b = 0, a div b * b + a mod b}
end t
--- power and negation
on t(a, b, c)
    return {a ^ b, a ^ (b ^ c), (a ^ b) ^ c, -a ^ b, (-a) ^ b, -(a ^ b), a ^ -b, a * b ^ c, (a * b) ^ c}
end t
--- text comparisons
on t(x)
    return {x = "a", x is "a", "a" is x, x < "b", x comes before "b", x is not "", x ≠ "", "" = x}
end t
--- is in forms
on t(x)
    return {x is in {1, 2, 3}, {x} is in {1, 2, 3}, x is not in {1, 2}, "a" is in x, x contains "a", {1, 2} contains x, x is in "abc"}
end t
--- equality with booleans
on t(x)
    return {x is true, x is false, x = true, x ≠ false, x is not true, true is x}
end t
--- equality with missing value
on t(x)
    return {x is missing value, x is not missing value, x = missing value, missing value is x, x ≠ missing value}
end t
--- number tests
on t(x)
    return {x mod 2 = 0, x mod 2 is 1, x div 10, x / 10, (x div 10) * 10, round x, round (x / 2), round x rounding up, round x rounding down, round x rounding toward zero, round x rounding as taught in school}
end t
--- string operations
on t(x)
    return {length of x, count of x, count x, count characters of x, count of characters of x, number of characters of x, number of words in x, reverse of characters of x, x's length, x's characters}
end t
--- offset
on t(x, y)
    return {offset of x in y, (offset of x in y) + 1, (offset of "a" in y) > 0}
end t
--- as in conditions
on t(x)
    if x as text is "1" then return 1
    if (x as integer) > 1 then return 2
    if x as text = "a" & "b" then return 3
    return 0
end t
--- chained comparisons need parens
on t(a, b, c)
    return {(a = b) = c, a = (b = c), (a < b) = (b < c), (a contains b) and (b contains c), (a = b) ≠ (b = c)}
end t
--- containment with a coercion
on t(a, b)
    return {a contains (b as text), (a as text) contains b, (a as text) starts with b, a starts with (b as text), (a as text) ends with b, a ends with (b as text), (a contains b) as text, a = b as text, a < b as text, a contains b & "x", a & b contains "x"}
end t
--- list concatenation building
on t(x)
    set l to {}
    set l to l & x
    set l to l & {x, x}
    set end of l to x
    set beginning of l to x
    copy x to end of l
    copy x to beginning of l
    return l
end t
